subject.title: fix(docs): keep external link audit focused on real link rot

question: Should the maintainer accept treating all external HTTP 5xx responses as non-actionable advisory noise in the scheduled link-rot report?
rationale: This is an intentional automation-policy tradeoff: it reduces upstream outage noise but also suppresses persistent 5xx reporting, so it needs owner judgment rather than an automated repair decision.

options.title: Accept the advisory policy
options.body: Merge after required checks complete, keeping 404/410 as link-rot failures and treating 5xx as upstream-service noise.

options.title: Retain 5xx reporting
options.body: Revise the workflow policy if maintainers want persistent upstream 5xx responses visible in the advisory error output.

recommendation.title: Accept the advisory policy
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks complete, keeping 404/410 as link-rot failures and treating 5xx as upstream-service noise.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the preceding audit workflow and authored the follow-up policy change.
